summaryZh: UCSD CSE Bioinformatics Group 研究生物信息学中的新型计算分析，面向基因组变异、转录本及其他分子表达、调控和生物网络等大规模数据。它是由多名教师、员工和学生组成的研究组，非单一PI实验室。
researchQuestions: 如何通过新的计算分析方法理解大规模基因组、表达和生物网络数据？
topics: 基因组变异与分子表达
基因调控与相互作用网络
methods: 大规模生物数据的计算分析

evidence.quote: The bioinformatics research group in CSE is a diverse and dynamic group of faculty, staff, and students engaged in research in all aspects of the field, with a focus on novel analyses of data from these technologies.
The data include measurements of genomic variation, change in expression of transcripts, proteins, metabolites.
CSE Bioinformatics is an integral part of an independent Bioinformatics PhD program on campus with faculty from across the campus
